established: Bayesian Dirichlet-Multinomial estimator (K=12, alpha_prior {0.5,1.0,2.0}) is correctly implemented: positive control (synthetic 12-state stochastic SPA, N=5000, seed=42) replicates parent EXP-PHYSICS-35578258358 bit-identically (observed 168/339/643 nats, null_median -78/-131/-116 nats, p=0.0005 at all alphas). C6 PASS. (result.json metrics.positive_control, audit.json recomputed_metrics)

On TodoMVC hash-SPA fragment-aware URL states, within-session shuffled-action null is well-centered (null_median -24.8 to -39.7 nats < 0 on all variants at all alphas). C1 formally passes. (result.json metrics.variants.*.per_alpha)

Observed log BF exceeds all 1999 within-session shuffled-action null samples on all 15 (variant × alpha) cells (p=0.0005 floor). C3 formally passes. The real action arrangement is statistically distinguishable from random shuffling. (result.json metrics.variants.*.per_alpha, controls.CTRL_NULL_WITHIN_SESSION_SHUFFLE_C3)
80 non-leakage transitions achieved per variant (6 sessions × 24 raw, 112 valid, 32 link-click leakages filtered). C5 passes on all 5 variants. (result.json metrics.variants.*.n_nl)

Vanillajs/react/svelte are bit-identical; vue/angular are bit-identical. Effective independent FSM types = 2 (4-state and 3-state deterministic). (audit.json CTRL_VARIANT_ISOMORPHISM, result.json metrics.variants)

Action-variable resolution: action_target is None on all NL records (link_click filtered); action_primitive is the only non-degenerate action encoding. log BF with action=action_target = 0.000000 exactly. (result.json controls.CTRL_DEGENERATE_ACTION_TARGET)
TodoMVC hash-SPAs are near-deterministic FSMs: B2 action-history K=3 accuracy 1.0, K2 determinism 85-94%. (result.json metrics.baselines.B2, metrics.variants.*.determinism_k2)
URL-only conditional MI (B1) is small but >0 (0.0581-0.0716 bits), confirming weak action signal conditional on current URL alone. (result.json metrics.baselines.B1_url_only_conditional_mi_bits)

do_not_assume: Do NOT assume C-WEB-DYNAMICS is validated or supported by this experiment. The frozen decision rule passes but the absolute model comparison favors memory-only. The claim ceiling is bounded to relative null separation on near-deterministic TodoMVC hash-SPAs.
Do NOT assume 5 independent variant replications. Effective independent FSM types = 2 (isomorphic pairs verified bit-identical).
Do NOT assume the estimator works on production SPAs, stochastic environments, or state spaces larger than 3-4 URL states. All evidence is on minimal TodoMVC hash-SPAs.
Do NOT assume K=12 is appropriate for data with S=3-4 observed states. K=12 over-penalizes and makes BF magnitudes incomparable to the synthetic setting where K matches n_states.
Do NOT treat the negative observed BF as evidence that URL-level state is always insufficient for action dynamics. The K-mismatch confound is unresolved.
Do NOT assume N=5000-scale validation was achieved. Actual N_NL=80 per variant (1.6% of target), 6 scripted near-identical sessions.
Do NOT promote any mechanism to Product Core. This is a physics measurement with narrowed ceiling; no product code was modified or tested.
